item.title: Victor Wembanyama wants the MVP award, and wants to leave no doubt by season's end
item.description: Victor Wembanyama is making it clear: He wants to win the NBA’s MVP award this season. The San Antonio star — moments after his team officially clinched its first Southwest Division title in nine seasons — detailed some elements of his MVP case on Monday night after the red-hot Spurs beat the Miami Heat 136-111 for their 22nd win in their last 24 games.

item.title: Airstrikes batter Iran as it attacks Israel and Gulf states, while diplomatic efforts gather pace
item.description: Airstrikes battered Iran and Iranian missiles and drones targeted Israel’s Tel Aviv and sites across the Mideast. Those attacks came Tuesday after President Donald Trump said the United States was in talks with the Islamic Republic to end the war. item.title: Locals speak out on ammonia leak in Mason City
item.description: On Saturday, some residents in Mason City were evacuated from their homes due to an ammonia leak that made several blocks of the city unsafe.

item.title: Geneva's CERN hails delicate test on transporting antimatter as a scientific success
item.description: Scientists at CERN took some antiprotons out for a spin in a never-tried-before test drive. Tuesday's experiment was hailed as a success. About 100 antiprotons traveled in a truck around CERN's Geneva campus and were transported back into the lab. Each particle had corresponding antiparticle, like an antiproton, exactly matching the particle but oppositely charged.
